title: ext.qwencode of AER records written by the qwencode.json mapper (C.10; D.24.3; closed member list)
description: Verbatim Qwen Code and harness fields without a core slot, and the mapper's recorded checks (sidecars, salvage, final text). Values copied from the source are untrusted, open JSON; the member names are closed. Not a published corpus schema in v0.1 (AD-10 row 13).

init.description: execution: the system init message's fields verbatim (session_id, cwd, model, permission_mode, qwen_code_version, tools, mcp_servers, slash_commands, agents)

result.description: execution: the result message's fields verbatim (subtype, is_error, num_turns, duration_ms, duration_api_ms, usage, permission_denials, stats)

salvage.description: execution: the salvage of an output cut by the capture (qwencode.truncated_salvage@1, D-577)

sidecars.description: execution: auxiliary role -> header artefact id (qwencode.unit_inputs@1)

final_text.description: execution: result.result against the last assistant text (qwencode.final_text_copy@1)

duration_ms.description: run scope: result.duration_ms verbatim (no clock asserted)

request.description: task_prompt fixture: where the request was joined from (qwencode.request_join@1)

placed_as.description: execution-rules fixture: where the harness placed it

messages.description: assistant message: one entry per Qwen assistant message of the block (array position, message id, model, stop_reason, usage, content block count)

tool_use_id.description: tool message: the tool_result block's tool_use_id verbatim

is_error.description: tool message: the tool_result block's is_error verbatim

parent_tool_use_id.description: user message: the message's parent_tool_use_id verbatim (a sub-agent's)

judge.description: judgement: the score record's index, step_count, exceeded_soft_iteration_cap, used_write_tool, timed_out and last_response_full verbatim; execution: the same fields of a score record without a score (no judgement is written; regen item 125 follow-up), located by a header src entry and D by qwencode.score_join@1
